t: The Saxby AmazonPro CCT LED flush ceiling or wall light is a robust and versatile all-in-one bulkhead, ideal for both commercial and domestic applications. This durable LED flush light offers a slim profile and is suitable for public spaces indoors and outdoors, including bathrooms in zone 1. It features three selectable LED colour temperatures (3000K, 4000K, and 6000K) and three wattages (9W, 14W, and 18W), providing flexible lighting options. Installation is straightforward with a fast-fit hinged gear tray and push-fit connector. The light has an IP65 rating for water and dust ingress protection and an IK10 rating for impact resistance, ensuring longevity and performance.
b: Suitable for Both Domestic & Commercial Applications
